purpose: Machine-readable routing index for canonical AI SLOP operators. Definitions remain authoritative in docs/.

operators.name: Property Unbundling / Ownership Transfer
operators.summary: Detach a property from its assumed host, assign it elsewhere, and propagate consequences.

operators.name: Axiom Fracture / Negative Load-Bearing Synthesis
operators.summary: Negate a hidden assumption while preserving the goal; make the negation itself carry the goal.

operators.name: Attentional Shadow Harvesting
operators.summary: Interrupt exhaustive focus on the obvious center and promote a neglected but legitimate node.

operators.name: Destructive Compression / Alien Substrate Transference
operators.summary: Strip a problem to a causal invariant, solve it in a foreign substrate, and bring back structure rather than costume.

operators.name: Error Axiomatization / Shadow Taxonomy
operators.summary: Promote a coherent near-misclassification into the minimum world where it is literally true, then reason rigorously there.

operators.name: Primitive Deletion / Constitutive Vacuum
operators.summary: Delete one load-bearing primitive without replacement and rebuild dependencies around the absence.

operators.name: Teleological Bootstrap Inversion
operators.summary: Fix a terminal condition first and reconstruct the present so the ending becomes causally inevitable.

operators.name: Kinetic Dissolution / Metabolic Vector Reorganization
operators.summary: Treat apparent objects as maintained flows, rates, gradients, and couplings; intervene in those processes.

operators.name: Omission-Field Cognition / Negative Semantic Triangulation
operators.summary: Keep a target real but forbid direct representation; reconstruct it from independent external consequences.

operators.name: Cybernetic Circuit Closure / Deutero-Learning
operators.summary: Close the loop sustaining a problem and alter the relational premise that keeps reproducing it.

operators.name: Ontological Decompilation + Cascading Recompilation
operators.summary: Replace a foundational primitive and rederive concepts that genuinely depend on it.

operators.name: Systemic Taxonomic Contagion / Ontological Parasite Protocol
operators.summary: Import a foreign lifecycle or rule system into host functions without importing its surface imagery.

operators.name: Oneiric Contamination / Identity Slippage
operators.summary: Assert an incompatible identity literally and minimally revise antecedents as consequences demand.

operators.name: Asynchronous Multi-Axial Shear + Minority-Axis Sovereignty
operators.summary: Run incompatible readings separately, crown the anomalous legitimate one, and use the others as resistance constraints.

operators.name: Alien Distance Metrics + Enforced Metric Turnover
operators.summary: Redefine conceptual nearness using an explicit nonstandard ruler; retire successful rulers in extended mode.

operators.name: Selective Cognitive Lesion / Primitive Ablation
operators.summary: Remove one narrow cognitive operation and force compensatory procedures while other reasoning remains intact.

operators.name: Synthetic Transducer Array / Downstream Umwelt
operators.summary: Create detectors for abstract properties and let their signals alter salience or action.

operators.name: Synthetic Valence Topology / Invented Emotion
operators.summary: Attach invented attraction, aversion, or protection responses to detectable triggers.

operators.name: Lossy Cognition / Forced Aliasing
operators.summary: Destroy representational dimensions until distant concepts collide, then reconstruct without restoring the loss.

operators.name: Procedural Taboo + Aftermath Calculus
operators.summary: Ban the direct route and easy workaround; accept the target only if it emerges as aftermath of another valid process.

operators.name: Generative Desire / Alien Utility Function
operators.summary: Keep task requirements hard while ranking valid candidates by an explicit nonstandard objective.

operators.name: Descendant Fitness / Progeny Selection
operators.summary: Breed candidates forward and select present seeds by the fertility of their descendants.

operators.name: Recall Mutation / Reconstructive Memory
operators.summary: Every recall is context-scarred; the scarred reconstruction becomes the next remembered version.

operators.name: Observational Crystallization / Attentional Collapse
operators.summary: Deliberate attention fixes a property while unexamined dimensions retain mutation freedom.

operators.name: Semantic Recoil / Interpreter State Mutation
operators.summary: A later concept revises earlier meaning and, when necessary, the interpreter rule itself.

operators.name: Meta-Genomic Speciation / Ecosystemic Axiom Breeding
operators.summary: Breed cognitive rules into irreducible offspring whose outputs alter the next fitness landscape.

operators.name: Separated Jurisdictions
operators.summary: Assign incompatible rule systems to different subsystems so they negotiate instead of blending.

operators.name: Anchor + Mutation Field
operators.summary: Hold one recognizable property stable while surrounding dimensions deform.

operators.name: Cross-Domain Simulation / Concept Transduction
operators.summary: Translate source-domain behavior into target-medium controls rather than importing vocabulary.

operators.name: Material Anchoring
operators.summary: Translate abstract geometry or relations into concrete material and fabrication behavior.

operators.name: Causal Artifact Chain
operators.summary: Specify a capture, transfer, or degradation process whose failures produce visible/audible artifacts.

operators.name: Observer / Medium Coupling
operators.summary: Subject the recording or observation apparatus to the same rule affecting the represented object.

operators.name: Symbolic Compression
operators.summary: Replace recurring structures with glyphs whose roles and inheritance are explicitly tracked.

operators.name: Token / Capability Tax
operators.summary: Systematically remove or mutate allowed expressive units across externally tracked cycles.

operators.name: Recursive Artifact Fossilization
operators.summary: Feed an accidental artifact into later conditioning so it may become persistent structure.

operators.name: Attractor Lock → Perturb
operators.summary: Characterize a recurring regime, perturb one variable, and observe absorption, escape, or reorganization.

operators.name: Hysteretic / Non-Commutative Iteration
operators.summary: Test whether ordered transformations, repeated cycles, and prior states leave irreversible residue.
